title: membraneSW operation
description: Spiral-wound membrane module — the SAME unit as `spiralWoundModule` under its compact name; both read the identical operation block. Spiral-wound membrane module (RO/NF), solved node by node along the feed channel: local flux from the transport law, osmotic back-pressure from the declared model, concentration polarisation from the film coefficient. One unit is one STAGE: `vessels` identical pressure vessels in parallel, each holding `elements` in series. Hardware in one of two forms — a `module` RECORD (a commercial element, a generic standard size Generic-2540/4040/8040/16040, or a laboratory flat-sheet cell, from the assets catalogue, kind membraneModule) or explicit (`area` + `length`). The nominal form `moduleDiameter` + `nModules` was retired 2026-10-24 and refuses, naming the Generic records. One inlet, two outlets bound positionally: retentate first, permeate second.

module.title: Module record
module.description: A commercial element or a laboratory cell named as a RECORD (assets catalogue or the case's constant/assets/, kind membraneModule): it supplies the active area, the leaf length (and leaf count), the channel -- either the feed SPACER record it is wound with (`feedSpacer`, kind feedSpacer: thickness, porosity, Schock & Miquel's Eq. 17 hydraulic diameter, its correlations and their Reynolds window) or an inline channelHeight + spacerPorosity -- and, for a commercial spiral element, the membrane; its limits {} are checked per vessel and per element and announced. Declaring `area`, `length`, `feedSpacer`, or channelHeight/spacerPorosity inside massTransfer/pressureDrop beside it refuses by name (one home). Every value the record marks `origin estimated` is announced on every run.

membrane.title: Membrane
membrane.description: Resolved by exact name in the assets catalogue (kind RO/NF) or the case's own records; it supplies A_w and the per-solute B_s. Required unless `module` names a commercial spiral element (which is wound with its own membrane); required BESIDE `module` when the module is a generic standard-size element or a flat-sheet cell (their records name no membrane).

area.title: Membrane area
area.description: Explicit-hardware form, together with `length`. The alternative is a `module` record (the standard sizes are Generic-2540/4040/8040/16040).

elements.title: Elements in series per vessel
elements.description: The elements in series in each pressure vessel: the retentate of one feeds the next. A REAL count is allowed (an optimisation driver varies it continuously); the fraction is marched as a shorter last element, announced.

vessels.title: Vessels in parallel
vessels.description: Identical pressure vessels in parallel in this stage. One vessel is solved on F/n and its outlets are scaled by n (exact for identical vessels; announced). A multi-stage array is built in the flowsheet, one unit per stage, with its interstage pump a unit of its own.

feedSpacer.title: Feed spacer record
feedSpacer.description: With the explicit `area` + `length` form only: a feed spacer RECORD (kind feedSpacer) that supplies the channel height, porosity and Eq. 17 hydraulic diameter, and the coefficients and Reynolds window of the correlation the massTransfer / pressureDrop block names. Beside `module` it refuses (the element record names its own).

dP_feed_total.title: Feed-channel pressure drop
dP_feed_total.description: Total friction drop along the feed channel, applied linearly. The `pressureDrop { model SchockMiquel; }` block computes it from the spacer geometry instead.

interElementDP.title: Inter-element pressure drop
interElementDP.description: Extra drop between elements of a multi-element vessel (interconnectors).

k_film.title: Film mass-transfer coefficient
k_film.description: Constant concentration-polarisation film coefficient. The `massTransfer {}` block computes it from a correlation instead.

nNodes.title: Axial nodes
nNodes.description: Discretisation along the module; defaults to 100.

transport.title: Transport law
transport.description: The inner J_w–c_m–c_p problem: `solutionDiffusion` (default), `DSPM-DE` (the pore-flow model for NF, with its announced internal Davies), `SDEM` (per-ion solution-diffusion coupled by the zero-current field) or `gelPolarisation` (ultrafiltration: pressure-controlled flux until the wall reaches the gel concentration, then J = k ln(c_g(1-S)/(c_b - S c_g)); its parameters in `transportParameters { gel {} }`).

transportParameters.title: Transport-law parameters
transportParameters.description: Parameters a transport law reads for itself (the block batchDiafilter hands its law too).  `gelPolarisation` reads `gel { solute <gel-forming solute>; c_gel <kg/m3>; sieving { <solute> <S>; ... }; source "..."; }` -- S in [0, 1) for EVERY solute, and `source` says where c_g and S come from.  `DSPM-DE` reads `poreSolver { method finiteDifference; nodes <n>; grid uniform | graded | adaptive; grading <beta>; gridTolerance <cells>; gridPasses <n>; wallClosure porePermeate | solutionDiffusion; }`, `hindrance DechadilokDeen2006;`, `activity wallDavies | ideal | bulkOverPoreDavies;` and `bulkDielectric <eps>;` -- and nothing else (an unknown key or word refuses).

poreSolver.title: DSPM-DE pore solver
poreSolver.description: How DSPM-DE crosses the pore: it is SOLVED (DEV.md 4c C138; the default since 2026-10-24, the only method since C142).  Absent = `method finiteDifference;` on 101 nodes, uniform, with `wallClosure porePermeate`, each default announced.  The extended Nernst-Planck equations on `nodes` grid points across the pore (faces included), electroneutrality at every node and zero current, and -- in the SAME Newton -- the film's interface balance at the wall and the water flux J_w = A_w (dP - dpi): one Newton per station on the declared block-tridiagonal structure with an analytic Jacobian.  NanoFiltran (Geraldes & Alves 2008) is the reference it is compared with.  `nodes` defaults to 101, announced.  `grid` is `uniform` (the default, announced), `graded` (the tanh map toward both faces of `grading`, 0 < beta <= 6 -- `grading` alone means graded; MEASURED not to help: the steep region of a mixed-counter-ion pore is an interior front) or `adaptive` (DEV.md 4c C144: the nodes equidistribute the curvature of the solved potential, |psi''|^(1/3) plus its mean, re-solved until no node moves by more than `gridTolerance` of its own cell -- default 0.1 -- in at most `gridPasses` re-solves per station -- default 8 -- the grid carried station to station; MEASURED at 0.76x the uniform error on an interior front and the same error on the corpus cases, which is why it is an option and not the default).  `grading` on a uniform or adaptive grid, `graded` with no grading, and `gridTolerance`/`gridPasses` on a fixed grid each refuse by name.  `wallClosure`: `porePermeate` (default) closes the multi-ionic wall with the solved pore's own permeate; `solutionDiffusion` closes it with the salts' solution-diffusion B_s, a permeate the pore does not make.  `method closedForm;` (the default until 2026-10-24) is RETIRED and refuses by name with its reason: it did not solve the pore, and with the corrected K_d its transmission tends to K_c > 1 at low Peclet number.  An unknown method word refuses.

gridTolerance.title: Adaptive grid: node movement accepted as settled (cells)

gridPasses.title: Adaptive grid: re-solves per station, at most

hindrance.title: DSPM-DE hindrance factors
hindrance.description: Absent = `DechadilokDeen2006`, the one pair (announced as the default): K_d = H/Phi (lambda <= 0.95; 0.984((1-lambda)/lambda)^2.5 above) and K_c their rational fit -- the cross-section-averaged pair (Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 45 (2006) 6953).  H, the Dechadilok-Deen polynomial, is Phi K_d.  `legacy` (H itself taken as K_d, so the steric partition counted twice in diffusion; the default until 2026-10-24) REFUSES by name, saying why.

activity.title: DSPM-DE activity treatment
activity.description: Absent = `wallDavies`: Davies at the bulk ionic strength on the feed face, the permeate ideal.  `ideal`: every activity coefficient 1.  `bulkOverPoreDavies`: gamma_bulk/gamma_pore at BOTH faces, Davies (log10) with A(eps, T) = 1.82483e6 (eps T)^-1.5 -- eps_b on the solution side, eps_p on the pore side, the pore gammas at the pore's end nodes; evaluated inside the station's Newton on the answer's own ionic strengths.

bulkDielectric.title: Bulk dielectric constant
bulkDielectric.description: The solution's relative dielectric constant in the Born term and in A(eps_b).  Absent = SolventProperties::epsWater(T) (78.45 at 25 C).

osmotic.title: Osmotic-pressure model
osmotic.description: Absent = van't Hoff (dilute). `{ model Pitzer; beta0 ...; beta1 ...; Cphi ...; }` prices phi(I) for a concentrated brine — at seawater strength phi ~ 0.92, so van't Hoff OVERSTATES the back-pressure and the difference is flux.

pressureDrop.title: Channel-friction model
pressureDrop.description: Computes the feed-channel drop from the spacer geometry instead of taking `dP_feed_total`.

model.title: Correlation
model.description: e.g. SchockMiquel (dP/dz = lambda rho u^2 / 2 d_h).

massTransfer.title: Concentration-polarisation model
massTransfer.description: Computes k_film from a Sherwood correlation instead of taking it as a constant.

polarisation.title: Polarisation policy
polarisation.description: The film's POLICY, one block whichever way k arrives (a correlation or a bare `k_film`); declaring these words inside massTransfer {} refuses. `suctionCorrection`: GeraldesAfonso2006 (Xi = phi + (1 + 0.26 phi^1.4)^-1.7), filmTheory (the default: Xi = phi + phi/(e^phi - 1)) or none. `ionCoupling`: electroneutral (the multi-ionic model of Geraldes & Afonso 2007 -- each ion's k on its own D0, one interface potential gradient fixed by electroneutrality at the wall; needs >= 2 charged solutes) or none (the default, announced on an ion-declared feed).
